source_caption_text:
Don Toliver has gone from being one of Travis Scott’s most promising discoveries to becoming a superstar in his own right. 🌵🔥

The Houston artist’s career changed dramatically in 2018 when Travis introduced millions of listeners to him on “CAN’T SAY” from ASTROWORLD. Don’s unusual high-pitched melodies and psychedelic sound immediately stood out, and shortly afterward he was announced as part of Travis Scott’s Cactus Jack Records.

Being connected to Travis gave Don a massive platform, but he quickly proved he wasn’t simply “Travis Scott’s artist.” His breakout hit “No Idea” exploded online, while projects like Heaven or Hell, Life of a DON, Love Sick and HARDSTONE PSYCHO helped establish his own identity.

Don’s sound sits somewhere between rap, R&B and psychedelic trap. His voice is arguably his biggest weapon — he can turn a simple melody into something instantly recognizable, which has made him one of the most sought-after artists for hooks and features.

The connection with Travis has remained a major part of his career. Songs like “CAN’T SAY,” “Euphoria,” “Flocky Flocky” and their other collaborations show why their styles work so naturally together. Both come from Houston and share that atmospheric, heavily produced approach to music, but Don has developed his own version of it.

What started as Travis Scott giving an upcoming Houston artist a life-changing feature eventually became something much bigger.

Don Toliver isn’t just Travis Scott’s protégé anymore — he’s become one of Cactus Jack’s biggest success stories. 🌵🚀🔥 #Explorepage #Explore #Viral #DonToliver #TravisScott
